content.short: Verda Ventures invests in founder-first, high-growth fintech and blockchain companies in emerging markets.
content.description: Verda Ventures backs founder-first, high-growth fintech and blockchain companies. Through the MiniPay Fund, it concentrates on the application layer of a rapidly expanding mobile wallet in emerging markets. Core verticals include remittances, cash-in cash-out, payments, identity, and stablecoin-based banking services. Verda provides technical, distribution, and capital support to accelerate product development and go-to-market strategies.
